title: 1952 AHSME Problem 2
statement: Two high school classes took the same test. One class of \(20\) students made an average grade of \(80\%\); the other class of \(30\) students made an average grade of \(70\%.\) The average grade for all students in both classes is:

solutions.text:
The two classes earned a combined total of \[ 20(80)+30(70)=3700 \] percentage points among \(50\) students. Their combined average is \(\frac{3700}{50}=74\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Weight each class average by the number of students in that class
